Automatically delete the render after a certain period. Accepted values are `1-day`, `3-days`, `7-days` and `30-days`.<br /> For this to work, your bucket needs to have [lifecycles enabled](/docs/lambda/autodelete).

## CLI flag

Use `--delete-after` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                             | Flag                     |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render) | `--delete-after <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)   | `--delete-after <value>` |

## API and configuration references

Follow a reference for the parameter name, default value, and examples in that API or configuration method.

| Reference                                                               | Name                      |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| [Configuration file](/docs/config#setdeleteafter)                       | `Config.setDeleteAfter()` |
| [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#deleteafter) | `deleteAfter`             |
| [`renderStillOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/renderstillonlambda#deleteafter) | `deleteAfter`             |
